content.short: Particle Network is a full-stack Web3 infrastructure platform providing modular account abstraction, social login, and cross-chain UX on Mantle.
content.description: Particle Network is a comprehensive Web3 infrastructure provider offering modular account abstraction, Wallet-as-a-Service (WaaS), and cross-chain interaction tooling. Its Smart WaaS product enables developers to embed fully functional Web3 wallets in their applications with social login support, gasless transactions, and batch operations  without users needing to understand seed phrases or gas. Particle's Universal Accounts provide a single account balance usable across all supported chains. The platform supports Mantle Network as part of its growing multi-chain ecosystem.
content.meta: Particle Network provides modular account abstraction and social login infrastructure for apps on Mantle. Discover Particle Network on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
